description: Na₃AsS₃ crystallizes in the cubic P2_13 space group. There are three inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner, edge, and face-sharing NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-60°. There are three shorter (3.02 Å) and three longer (3.12 Å) Na-S bond lengths. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-44°. There are three shorter (2.82 Å) and three longer (3.00 Å) Na-S bond lengths. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-42°. There are three shorter (2.83 Å) and three longer (3.00 Å) Na-S bond lengths. As³⁺ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent S²⁻ atoms. All As-S bond lengths are 2.26 Å. S²⁻ is bonded to six Na¹⁺ and one As³⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing SNa₆As pentagonal bipyramids.
